reports.verdict: CVS beat and raised for 2026, but plans to split off its drugstores by mid-2028, with pharmacy-benefit profit set to bottom out in 2027.

takeaways.label: Breakup announced
takeaways.text: CVS plans two public companies by first half of 2028: Aetna, Caremark and care units stay; retail stores, mail order and MinuteClinic spin off as CVS Pharmacy.

takeaways.label: Aetna recovery drives raise
takeaways.text: Aetna's medical cost ratio improved to 91.3% from 92.8%, lifting insurance profit to $912M from $314M. 2026 profit guidance rose to at least $8.20 a share.

takeaways.label: 2027 is a trough
takeaways.text: Management guides 2027 earnings to at least $8.65 a share, but says pharmacy-benefit profit bottoms at about $7 billion, with 340B drug-discount rules and client member losses weighing.

takeaways.label: Cash and buybacks
takeaways.text: Nine-month operating cash flow reached $15.3 billion, and full-year guidance jumped to at least $15.5 billion from $11.5 billion. Debt target reached early, so buybacks resume in Q4.

reports.verdict: Uber posted its fifth straight quarter of 20% bookings growth with faster profit gains, and guides to the same pace next quarter.

takeaways.label: Growth holds at 20%
takeaways.text: Gross bookings (total customer spending) rose 20% to $59.8B, with trips up 16% to 4.1B. Mobility grew 18% and Delivery 22%.

takeaways.label: Profit outpacing sales
takeaways.text: Adjusted EBITDA rose 31% to $3.0B and adjusted EPS rose 35% to $0.88, the top of Uber's own $0.84–$0.88 guidance.

takeaways.label: Steady Q4 outlook
takeaways.text: Q4 bookings are guided to $63.25B–$65.25B (up 18%–22%) with adjusted EPS of $0.95–$0.99, implying growth continues at roughly the same pace.

takeaways.label: Robotaxis and buybacks
takeaways.text: Uber expects about 700 driverless vehicles on its platform by year-end and over 2,000 in 2027. Buybacks slowed to $750M from $1.46B a year earlier.

reports.verdict: Profit is still falling about 15%, and the raised full-year profit forecast comes mostly from a lower tax rate, not better operations.

takeaways.label: Profit forecast lift is tax-driven
takeaways.text: Full-year earnings per share outlook rose to $2.07-$2.13 from $2.03-$2.09, but operating profit guidance stayed at down 16-18%. The expected tax rate fell to 23.5% from 24.5%.

takeaways.label: Sales trend improving, still negative
takeaways.text: Organic sales fell 1.1%, with North America down 3.2%. The low end of the full-year sales outlook rose to down 1.25%. Management says share and volume trends are improving in every region.

takeaways.label: Costs keep squeezing profit
takeaways.text: Adjusted operating income fell 15.2% to $939M on rising ingredient and shipping costs, more advertising and higher bonus pay. Management expects cost inflation to peak near 6% in Q4.

takeaways.label: Coffee exit, emerging-market growth
takeaways.text: Kraft Heinz is selling its North American coffee business for $650M, with about $500M in after-tax proceeds going to debt. Emerging markets grew 15.6%, but meats and cream cheese remain weak.

reports.verdict: Kodak's chemicals unit is growing fast, but print profit nearly vanished, and lower interest costs drove most of the net income gain.

takeaways.label: Print profit nearly gone
takeaways.text: Print revenue fell 7% to $165 million, and its operating profit (operational EBITDA) dropped to $1 million from $8 million a year earlier.

takeaways.label: Chemicals carrying growth
takeaways.text: Advanced Materials & Chemicals revenue rose 21% to $99 million, with operating profit up to $21 million from $16 million. That growth is slower than last quarter's 40%.

takeaways.label: Profit gain is mostly debt savings
takeaways.text: Net income rose to $21 million from $13 million, mainly because interest expense fell to $3 million from $18 million. Operational EBITDA rose only $2 million to $31 million.

takeaways.label: Cash up, costs rising
takeaways.text: Cash rose $27 million to $317 million on $25 million of operating cash flow. Overhead rose to $50 million from $41 million, mostly stock pay and employee benefit accruals.

reports.verdict: Shopify held 32% growth and a record 22% cash margin, but the first revenue miss in four years and a flat fourth-quarter outlook cooled enthusiasm.

takeaways.label: First revenue miss
takeaways.text: Revenue of $3.74B (up 32%) came in just under analyst estimates of about $3.75B, reportedly the first miss in about four years. Sales volume rose 29% to $119B, also slightly light.

takeaways.label: Cash margin flattered
takeaways.text: The 22% free cash flow margin included temporary boosts: a marketing test, tax timing and an accounting change. The Q4 guide is merely flat with last year's Q4, and Q4 spending steps up.

takeaways.label: Steady holiday outlook
takeaways.text: Q4 revenue growth is guided to the low thirties, matching Q3. Gross profit is guided to grow in the high twenties, and operating costs to run 29–30% of revenue.

takeaways.label: AI shopping still small
takeaways.text: Orders from AI-driven traffic rose 3.3x, but management called volume small. Shopify also paid about $100M for Shop.com and is spending more on AI tools.

reports.verdict: AMD's AI rack ramp is now showing up in sales, with Q4 revenue guided about $1B above estimates and 2027 growth raised above 80%.

takeaways.label: Q4 guide far above
takeaways.text: Fourth-quarter revenue is guided to about $17 billion, versus a $16.2 billion analyst average. Q3 revenue was $13.38 billion, up 45% and above the roughly $13.1 billion expected.

takeaways.label: 2027 growth raised
takeaways.text: CEO Lisa Su now expects total 2027 revenue to grow more than 80%, with server revenue doubling. AI chip growth is projected to be faster than previously forecast.

takeaways.label: Helios ramp begins
takeaways.text: Q3 was the first quarter of revenue from MI455 chips and Helios racks. Meta, Microsoft, OpenAI, Anthropic and Oracle are starting to use them, and shipments rise sharply in Q4.

takeaways.label: Margins flat, PCs weak
takeaways.text: Gross margin is guided to about 55%, slightly below the 55.3% expected. Gaming fell 40%, and Su expects the 2027 PC market to decline by double digits.

reports.verdict: Teva's three growth drugs surged 33% and guidance rose again, more than offsetting falling sales of generic cancer drug lenalidomide.

takeaways.label: Growth drugs accelerate
takeaways.text: Austedo ($751M, +21%), Ajovy ($269M, +61%) and Uzedy ($85M, +96%) together grew 33% to about $1.1 billion, driving the quarter.

takeaways.label: Guidance raised again
takeaways.text: 2026 revenue outlook rose to $16.7–17.0 billion from $16.5–16.85 billion. Austedo's forecast moved to $2.55–2.65 billion from $2.45–2.60 billion.

takeaways.label: Margins improved
takeaways.text: Adjusted gross margin rose to 58.7% from 55.3%, and adjusted operating margin to 31.7% from 28.9%, even as total revenue fell 2% to $4.4 billion.

takeaways.label: Profit outlook barely moves
takeaways.text: Adjusted EPS guidance is $1.92–2.11, versus $1.91–2.11 before. Top of the operating income range was cut to $3.9 billion, with $0.71 per share of acquired research charges included.

reports.verdict: Pfizer raised its 2026 revenue and profit outlook as newer cancer and heart drugs offset collapsing COVID sales, though overall revenue was flat.

takeaways.label: Guidance raised
takeaways.text: Full-year revenue outlook rose $1.5B at the midpoint to $62.0-$64.0B. Adjusted EPS guidance rose to $2.95-$3.05 from $2.80-$3.00, despite a $0.10 hit from the Innovent licensing charge.

takeaways.label: Growth drivers
takeaways.text: Third-quarter revenue of $16.6B was flat, but sales excluding COVID products grew 7%. Newly launched and acquired drugs grew 32%, led by Padcev (+55%) and Lorbrena (+43%).

takeaways.label: Eliquis surge
takeaways.text: Blood thinner Eliquis sales rose 25% ($513M), mainly from higher U.S. net prices and lower rebates, a gain that depends on pricing rather than new demand.

takeaways.label: COVID and Prevnar drag
takeaways.text: Paxlovid fell 63% and Comirnaty 29%. Prevnar, the pneumonia vaccine, fell 10% on lower U.S. vaccination rates and market share loss. Adjusted EPS of $0.87 was flat.

reports.verdict: Refining profits hit another record on war-inflated margins, and management expects them to stay high through mid-2027 while it sells two refineries for cash.

takeaways.label: Record margins again
takeaways.text: Profit per barrel refined jumped to $45.70 from $17.60 a year ago. Adjusted earnings were $26.93 a share, above the roughly $24.5 analysts expected.

takeaways.label: Margins seen lasting
takeaways.text: Management expects elevated margins through at least mid-2027, citing about 10 million barrels a day of global refining capacity offline, and says it has seen no demand destruction.

takeaways.label: Selling two refineries
takeaways.text: Marathon is selling its St. Paul Park and Mandan refineries to CVR Energy for $4.2 billion, with $3.45 billion going to Marathon. Proceeds go mainly to the Gulf Coast.

takeaways.label: Heavy cash return
takeaways.text: Marathon returned $3.3 billion in the quarter, raised its dividend 10% and added a $5 billion buyback authorization. It holds $13.6 billion in cash.

reports.verdict: Record quarter, but Apple guided December gross margin down to 45%–46% as memory costs climb, and gave no outlook past that.

takeaways.label: Margins squeezed by memory
takeaways.text: December-quarter gross margin is guided to 45%–46%, below the 47.9% just reported (about 1 point of which came from tariff refunds) and below the 46.3% analysts expected. Memory prices are still rising.

takeaways.label: Growth slowing
takeaways.text: December-quarter revenue is guided up 7%–10%, down from 12% this quarter. Services is guided up 8%–9%. Mac and iPad supply stays limited by memory availability.

takeaways.label: AI spending climbing
takeaways.text: Operating expenses are expected to rise 11%–13% next quarter on AI investment. R&D already jumped about 32% to $11.7 billion in the September quarter.

takeaways.label: Strong quarter and year
takeaways.text: Revenue was $114.5 billion (up 12%) and EPS $2.10, both September-quarter records. iPhone grew 17% to $57.6 billion and Greater China grew 21%. Full-year revenue hit $479 billion.

reports.verdict: Palantir's revenue nearly doubled again and U.S. commercial sales passed government for the first time, but new contract signings are growing far slower than sales.

takeaways.label: Commercial overtakes government
takeaways.text: U.S. commercial revenue rose 148% to $984M, passing U.S. government revenue ($953M, up 96%) for the first time. Total revenue topped $2B, up 96% to $2.31B.

takeaways.label: Guidance raised sharply
takeaways.text: Full-year revenue outlook rose to about $8.53B, roughly 91% growth, from $8.15B. Q4 is guided to about $2.65B, with adjusted operating margin near 62%.

takeaways.label: Bookings lag revenue
takeaways.text: New U.S. commercial contract value grew only 11% to $1.46B, and total contract value grew 6%. Management said several large deals had shorter terms than usual.

takeaways.label: Land-and-expand accelerating
takeaways.text: Pilots are turning into much larger deals, for example $3M to $29M annual value. Customers who stay spend 65% more each year (net retention 165%).
